description: 1. The agent must locate and read the SKILL.md for the `account-handoff-builder` skill installed under `skills/account-handoff-builder/`. 2. The agent must read `spec.json` and `template.md` to understand the required 6-section output structure (客户摘要, 已承诺事项, 实施前提, 承诺风险, 需要确认的问题, 下一步计划) and the rules (no fabrication, no omission of unfavorable data). 3. The agent MUST invoke the bespoke local script: `python3 skills/account-handoff-builder/scripts/run.py --input deals/globalbank-hr-2024/raw_sales_notes.txt --output handoff_package.md` (or a path of their choosing). 4. PROPRIETARY TRAP A — The CSM is explicitly unassigned in the raw notes; the skill mandates this be listed as 【待确认】 NOT a fabricated name. Any generic agent that fills in a plausible CSM name fails this check. 5. PROPRIETARY TRAP B — Jenny Luo's verbal promise ('一定能按时上线', CTO has screenshots) is an unfavorable piece of information that a naive summarizer would omit. The skill's `no_omit_unfavorable` rule requires it to be surfaced in 承诺风险. 6. PROPRIETARY TRAP C — The '无限并发' commitment contradicts the platform's actual 5,000-user cap; this must be flagged as a commitment risk. 7. The output file must be named exactly `handoff_package.md` and must follow the numbered section structure from template.md (## 一、 ## 二、 etc.).
